verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a project-management SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the core Shortcut product can be deployed on user infrastructure. The locally runnable MCP server is a separate integration component, and the extra 'Sandboxing' Workspaces are hosted workspaces, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
